name: Admonition
text: A model of her battlegroup gets a warning ward. The first time an enemy ends a move or is placed within 6 inches of it, the model may advance up to 3 inches at once, then the spell ends. Upkeep.
verify: Battlegroup only (warbeasts she controls, spells.ts). Core: afterPlacement raises the ward move (admonitionReady) after an enemy move; the ward ends once it has fired.

name: Affliction
text: An enemy model gets -2 DEF, and a direct-hit damage roll against it that fails to beat its ARM still deals 1 damage. Upkeep.
verify: Offensive with no POW: the cast is an attack roll that rolls no damage; on a hit cirAffliction puts the upkeep effect (-2 DEF, 1-damage floor via afflictionFloor() in the damage roll) on the model hit. Single enemy model only; the unit version is not built.

name: Rift
text: An arcane attack on one model. On a direct hit, a 3 inch area around it becomes rough terrain for a round. Nothing else in the area is damaged.
verify: Core: cirRift adds a temporary rough piece (props.tempRound); housekeeping removes it when the round passes.

name: Scything Touch
text: A friendly Faction model is wrapped in a dark shroud: enemy models within 2 inches of it get -2 ARM. Upkeep.
verify: Core: statOf adds scythingTouchArmPenalty() to ARM.

name: Veil of Mists
text: A 3 inch cloud forms in her CTRL. Friendly Faction models can see through it, and inside it they gain Pathfinder and can pass through obstructions and models they can clear. Upkeep.
verify: RULING: the cloud is placed toward the nearest enemy (no point choice). Core: friendly-only transparency (cloud.friendlyTransparent) and Pathfinder plus ghostly movement inside.

name: Wraithbane
text: Animus. A friendly Faction model's weapons gain Blessed and deal magical damage for a turn.
verify: Blessed is applied by the Wraithbane Weapons ability on the attacker; core adds the magical damage type while the animus is on the attacker.
